Basic setup for mosquito ecology models

Source: R/xds_setup.R
xds_setup_mosy.Rd

Build a basic model to study mosquito ecology. This is a modified version of xds_setup that streamlines setup for models without parasite / pathogen infection dynamics.

This sets class(xds_obj$frame) = 'mosy' to dispatch functions that compute derivatives (xde), update variables (dts), and parse outputs. Models ignore infection dynamics (the X and Y processes). The XH component is set up to handle human/host population density.

Choose a module to use for the mosquito dynamical components (see xds_info_dynamical_components):

  • MYname – adult mosquito ecology (see MY_module_list)

  • Lname – aquatic mosquito ecology (see L_module_list)

Set up the model structure:

  • nPatches - the number of patches (see xds_info_patch_dynamics)

  • membership - the habitat membership vector (see xds_info_aquatic_habitats)

During setup:

  • The structural parameter nHabitats is set to length(membership)

  • The structural parameter nStrata is set to nPatches

  • nPatches is checked and set to max(membership, nPatches)

Set parameter values and initial conditions using setup options (named lists):

  • MYoptions sets parameter values and initial conditions for the MY module

  • Loptions sets parameter values and initial conditions for the L module

  • HPop sets the human population density

If nPatches\(>1\), set up some basic aspects of egg laying, blood feeding, mosquito spatial dynamics, and exposure:

  • searchQ the habitat search weights (see xds_info_search_weights_habitat)

  • Koptions sets up a mosquito dispersal matrix (see xds_info_mosquito_dispersal)

Usage

xds_setup_mosy(
  model_name = "unnamed",
  xds = "ode",
  MYname = "basicM",
  Lname = "basicL",
  nPatches = 1,
  membership = 1,
  HPop = 1000,
  searchQ = list(),
  MYoptions = list(),
  Koptions = list(),
  Loptions = list()
)

Arguments

model_name

is a name for the model

xds

is xde for differential equations or dts for discrete time systems

MYname

the name of an MY module (see MY_module_list)

Lname

the name of an L module (see L_module_list)

nPatches

the number of patches

membership

is a vector that describes the patch where each aquatic habitat is found

HPop

the initial human population density for each stratum

searchQ

is a vector of search weights for egg laying

MYoptions

a list to configure the MY Component module

Koptions

a mosquito dispersal matrix (\(K\)) or setup options (see setup_K_matrix)

Loptions

a list to configure the L Component module

Value

an xds object

See also

xds_setup and dMYdt.basicM
